problem: Completed assistant responses rendered MessageActionBar and HoverCopyBar together. Since each contained a copy button, the UI displayed two identical copy icons.
solution: Added one presentation policy that selects primary actions, hover-copy fallback, or no actions. MessageBubbleView now renders exactly one selected action surface instead of stacking both bars.
lesson: Mutually exclusive action surfaces should be chosen by one presentation policy. Independent visibility conditions can overlap and duplicate controls even when each component is correct in isolation.
